answer: Random peer audit makes each agent a vertex in a graph. Each epoch, two random peers re-check ten actions; a whisper of doubt triggers a five-reviewer audit. Honest agents pay 2 POA per epoch, but a sybil ring forging 1,000 fake histories pays 1,000 x 2 = 2,000 POA and loses deposits on any failed audit. Truthful agents draw nectar from the review pool, emission fakes never dilute, since failed audits burn the attacker's stake.
